theme: An open Saturday — the last full day with the girls before tomorrow's handoff.
greeting: Nothing is on the calendar today, Dan — the whole day is yours in St. Pete with the girls before they go to Jen's tomorrow. The one thing worth a few minutes is getting ahead of tomorrow's Sunday review, where a cluster of overdue travel bookings is waiting.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review has a backlog
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at 9 AM with Mike. Three booking windows are open on the board — arrive ready to actually decide December, the Christmas rental, and the Pathfinder drive rather than roll them a fourth week.

needsAttention.title: December trip — book by Oct 15
needsAttention.detail: All four kids, Dec 13 to Jan 2. The decision was due Sept 30 and booking closes Oct 15; holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year. Lean domestic, since the passports won't be in hand at booking time.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out. Book refundable now and adjust dates later — it's a p1 already two weeks overdue.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Portland to St. Pete drive window opens in two days. Once the dates are set, book the single hotel night the two-day route needs.

flagged.title: AppleCare One needs a sign-in
